note: PROPOSED, NOT SHIPPED. D5 full category list (63 categories, 17 groups), kept for when new reference categories are offered to users (R3 section 8: offered, never added). The build ignores this folder. D5 draft rev 2. Shape follows R3 section 5.2 (id, name, icon, essential, bucketRole, keywords, source, reviewed) plus group, kind, usuallyBill, legacyCategoryId, countsAs. kind is expense, income, transfer or refund. kind "transfer" is what calc/transfers.js isTransferRow recognises (category.kind === "transfer" or id "transfer"); those rows are not spending. "refund" is its own kind: netted against the matched spending category, never income. reviewed=null means no human review yet. keywords are whole-word phrases (not the app's substrings), copied from the keyword rows of the merchant file. bucketRole follows R3 (essential daily, rest splurge) except six non-essential rows that stay daily (parking, BNPL, fees, interest, payment to person, cash): a deliberate deviation.
